movement_profile.footwork: Heel leads forward steps; backward steps push off heel; feet stay close to floor except slight leg raise in dips; step sequence SSQQ with variations
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Danced as couples in close embrace; requires ample space for long steps and fluid movement
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Close contact and coordinated movement; frequent dips and rotations
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: No jumps or aerials; low and horizontal movement
movement_profile.partnering: Close contact with pelvis and upper body; no kicks or aerials
movement_profile.posture: Close contact with pelvis, upper thighs, and upper body; low dance position with bent supporting leg

signature_moves.description: Follower slightly raises left leg while dipping
signature_moves.name: Dip

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Slow and deliberate with rhythmic variations matching music

music_profile.meter: not explicitly described; rhythm follows ballroom tango with habanera and beguine influences
music_profile.musical_form: Verse-chorus with rhythm changes during chorus
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Typical Finnish rhythm pattern with habanera; chorus sections switch to beguine rhythm
music_profile.sound_description: Finnish tango music features accordion-led melodies with drum accompaniment, shifting rhythms between habanera and beguine patterns, and melancholic minor-key vocal lines reflecting Finnish nature and emotional themes.
music_profile.vocal_style: Melancholic lyrics in minor keys, themes of love, sorrow, nature

basic_steps: Alternate step sequences QQS or SQQ for rhythm changes
teaching.formation: Couple dance in close contact with pelvis, upper thighs, and upper body connected
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with SSQQ basic step sequence; skilled dancers vary slows and quicks to match melody and rhythm
teaching.rhythm: Slow, slow, quick, quick (SSQQ) with variations to QQS or SQQ
